rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an opponent or rival in a contest, conflict, or general opposition.

example.english: We need to be careful in this match because the adversary is very strong in attack.
example.traditional: 今場波我哋要小心啲，對手攻擊力好強。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 deoi3 sau2 gung1 gik1 lik6 hou2 koeng4

rows.note: Use this instead of 對手 when the adversary is a hostile enemy who attacks or is engaged in a serious conflict.

example.english: On the battlefield, the adversary suddenly attacked from behind.
example.traditional: 戰場上，敵人突然由後面殺出嚟。
example.jyutping: zin3 coeng4 soeng6 dik6 jan4 dat6 jin4 jau4 hau6 min6 saat3 ceot1 lai4
